lede: Almost everything this sector is required to place sits **inside the cloud**, and the events are written around the blackout — you cannot tell whether the intruders are already aboard, what is inside the derelict station, or where the damaged Federation ship went. The fog is supposed to buy time, but the Rebels came prepared for it: a nebula jump here shortens their advance by only about **a fifth** where the same beacon elsewhere would halve it, and four events hand them a whole extra jump while nothing gives one back.

section_notes.NEBULA_HOSTILE: Assembled out of the Rebel and pirate nebula lists, which is why {{NEBULA_EMPTY}} sits in it twice — a hostile allocation can land on nothing at all. Three of the rest are plasma storms, where your reactor runs at half capacity.
section_notes.NEBULA_NEUTRAL: Nothing in this pool opens hostile; every ship here lets you decide whether to shoot. {{NEBULA_ROCK_RACIST}} is the odd one — a plasma storm despite the list, and its Rockman option pays a full standard reward for leading them out.
section_notes.NEBULA_EMPTY: Four beacons of nothing but gas and a charging FTL. The only pool in the sector that cannot cost you anything — and it turns up inside the hostile pool as well.
section_notes.DISTRESS_BEACON: The generic distress list, untouched by the nebula: none of these events carry an environment of their own. It is also the only line with any give in it — roll high on everything above and a single beacon is left for a line that wants three, so the sector's clear space is the first thing it drops. All three quest starts — {{CIVILIAN_ASTEROIDS_BEACON}}, {{REBEL_VS_FEDERATION}} and {{ESCORT_BEACON}} — are in here.

items.text: The sector's best key: past the guard at {{NEBULA_AUTO_DEFENSE_ITEM}}, out of the storm fight at {{STORM_AUTO}}, past the Rebel picket at {{NEBULA_REBEL_UNDETECTED}}, and graded across three levels at {{DISTRESS_SATELLITE_DEFENSE}}.
The blackout workaround — tracks the drifting crew at {{NEBULA_LOST_SHIP}} and holds the lock at {{NEBULA_REBEL_CHASE}}, which otherwise loses them or loses you.

Both buy the same certain engagement at {{NEBULA_REBEL_CHASE}} — but only the augment still works once you are in the cloud, and Sensors' other payoff, {{TRADER_UPGRADES}}, is one of the few beacons here that is not in one.
Level 3 or 6 to run from {{STORM_AUTO}}, level 4 to break contact at {{NEBULA_REBEL_UNDETECTED}} once you have been spotted.
The clean answer at {{NEBULA_LOST_SHIP}} — a crew member and scrap with no roll at all — plus options at {{CIVILIAN_ASTEROIDS_BEACON}} and {{REBEL_VS_FEDERATION}}.
Hacking opens two graded routes into {{NEBULA_AUTO_DEFENSE_ITEM}}, both costing a drone part; Rockman pays at {{NEBULA_ROCK_RACIST}}, {{DISTRESS_STATION_FIRE}} and {{DISTRESS_STATION_DISEASE}}.
Over half the pool can hand you someone — {{NEBULA_LOST_SHIP}}, {{STORM_ITEMS}}, {{STRANDED_BEACON}} and the hiring station at {{TAVERN_HIRE}} among them.
No named item drops in this sector — every weapon in the pool is a random one. {{NEBULA_WEAPONS_TRADER}} sells one unseen for 45 scrap, and one branch takes the scrap and hands over nothing.
{{NEBULA_AUTO_DEFENSE_ITEM}} is the sector's loot box — a drone schematic, a weapon, a haul of resources, or a stripped hull with nothing in it.
{{NEBULA_TRADER}} swaps fuel, missiles and drone parts in both directions, {{NEBULA_PIRATE_SMUGGLE}} pays a fuel bribe to a Weapon Control 6 threat, and {{REFUEL_STATION}} sits in the item pool.

You cannot confirm you have been boarded at {{NEBULA_BOARDING}}, cannot see inside the hull at {{NEBULA_AUTO_DEFENSE_ITEM}}, and cannot find the Federation ship at {{NEBULA_LOST_SHIP}} without help. The writing assumes the blackout.

{{STORM_REBEL}}, {{STORM_AUTO}}, {{STORM_ITEMS}} and {{NEBULA_ROCK_RACIST}} trade fog for a storm and half a reactor; {{STORM_REBEL}} starts shooting on arrival. Zoltan crew and a Backup Battery are the only power the storm does not touch.
{{NEBULA_BOARDING}} (2–4 humans) and {{NEBULA_REBEL_BOARDING}} (3–4) open with an alarm and no ship to shoot back at. {{REFUGEE_GHOST}} is the third.
Six events can cost a crew member outright. {{STORM_ITEMS}} is the sector's own: searching the wrecks blind also risks 4 hull damage and a breach.

{{NEBULA_AUTO_WARNING}}, {{NEBULA_REBEL_UNDETECTED}}, {{NEBULA_REBEL_CHASE}} and {{CIVILIAN_ASTEROIDS_BEACON}} each hand the fleet a full extra jump, and nothing in the pool gives one back. The thin nebula discount is the only counterweight there is.

Inside a cloud the system does nothing — no enemy interiors, no charge bars, whatever level you bought. **Slug crew**, which these stores carry more readily than any other non-human, and the **Lifeform Scanner** are the only two things that still see.
